## 维护者速读
- 是什么：一个空会话界面组件，三处共用：AI 首页（#37788）、全屏新会话、窄抽屉新会话（紧凑版）。问候、大输入框、示例问题、「最近会话 · 标题」。

## What to do
1. One component, three uses: AI home (#37788), full-screen new chat, narrow drawer (compact).
2. Resolve the three overlaps with #37788:
   - Each suggestion carries a mode, "send" or "fill". App-configured suggestions on the AI home send (as #37788 does); platform per-page suggestions in the drawer that involve the current record fill.
   - 「最近会话」: on the AI home open on that page (`?c=`), because the drawer is hidden there; in the drawer open in the drawer.
   - Suggestion source: the AI home uses the app's `ai:chat` nav-item params (#37787); the drawer uses platform suggestions by page type.
3. Greeting (time of day + name) and per-page suggestions are new strings in eleven locales.
4. Today's static per-agent suggestions live in `AiChatPage.tsx:1830,2123-2149`.

## Acceptance
- AI home: 「最近会话」 opens on the page; suggestions send or fill per mode, matching #37788.
- Full-screen and drawer new chats show the layout; compact in the narrow drawer.
